'''Gorobei''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Battlefronts">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Gorobei system/Legends|Gorobei system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="CWM18" /> including the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]<ref name="BH">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref><ref name="Insider132">{{InsiderCite|132|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Who's Who: The Bounty Hunters!}}</ref> [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita]]<ref name="Battlefronts" /> and [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]].<ref name="Insider132" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gorobei was first mentioned in<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[June 21]], [[2010]]<ref name="DK">{{DK|url=us/9780756663087-star-wars-the-clone-wars-character-encyclopedia|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|nolive=1}}</ref> reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Gorobei [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square M-8.<ref name="EAOC" />

''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'' established Gorobei as the homeworld of the character Rumi Paramita,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who debuted in "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]],"<ref name="BH" /> the [[April 2]], 2010 seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. "Bounty Hunters" is an homage to [[Wikipedia:Akira Kurosawa|Akira Kurosawa]]'s<ref name="EpisodeGuide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> [[Wikipedia:1954|1954]] film [[Wikipedia:Seven Samurai|''Seven Samurai'']],<ref name="SWcom">{{SW|url=news/akira-kurosawa-star-wars-influence|text=Five Films that Inspired ''Star Wars'' Storytellers}}</ref> and there is also a character in that film named (in [[Wikipedia:Japanese language|Japanese]]) 片山五郎兵衛 (''Katayama Gorōbei'').<ref name="SevenSamurai">{{VisualMediaCite|title=[[Wikipedia:Seven Samurai|''Seven Samurai'']]|director=[[Wikipedia:Akira Kurosawa|Akira Kurosawa]]|prod=[[Wikipedia:Toho|Toho]]|year=[[Wikipedia:1954|1954]]}}</ref>
